source: Supplementary Product Update 2026-10-07 supplied by user: Voice Agents. Existing booking/receptionist content retained separately. Industry dialogues are illustrative configurations, not customer results.

seo.title: AI calling agent for inbound, outbound and web voice | Steps AI
seo.description: Talk to customers on the web or phone in English, Hindi and Telugu. Qualify leads, run outbound call campaigns, transfer calls and manage voice conversations in Steps AI.

hero.title: A conversation starts. Your next step takes shape.
hero.body: Answer inbound calls, speak to leads and let website visitors talk to your AI agent. Give every call a purpose, from understanding a course enquiry to connecting a customer with your team.
hero.reassurance: Web voice, inbound and outbound calls. English, Hindi and Telugu. Connected to your inbox and CRM.

walkthrough.title: Set up the conversation before the phone rings.
walkthrough.intro: Configure your agent in the dashboard, then choose the flow for each type of call.

steps.label: Connect your telephony provider
steps.note: Connect a provider from the dashboard for real phone calls. Inbound calls reach the business agent linked to the number dialled.

steps.label: Choose the voice and greeting
steps.note: In Agent → Voice, choose a language, preview the greeting and add pronunciations for names.

steps.label: Select a qualification flow
steps.note: Save several flows per agent. Choose which questions are used for inbound calls, outbound calls and each campaign.

steps.label: Review calls and follow up
steps.note: Find voice conversations in the Inbox and qualified leads in their own view. Recordings are stored for review.

capabilities.title: Built around what happens next.
capabilities.intro: Voice is part of the same agent, inbox and CRM your team already uses.

items.title: Ask the questions that matter
items.body: Build qualification flows for your business. The agent chooses the next question, handles refusals and requests to repeat, and ends the call politely.

items.title: Reach leads with a campaign
items.body: Run outbound campaigns with automatic pacing. Calls can retry after no answer, a busy line or a temporary error.

items.title: Respect the do-not-call list
items.body: Outbound calling respects the do-not-call list. Manage phone numbers and start an AI call from the CRM.

items.title: Bring in your team
items.body: Transfer a call to a person when the conversation needs human help.

items.title: Keep after-hours enquiries
items.body: Calls outside business hours leave a voicemail that becomes a callback ticket.

items.title: Keep voice alongside chat
items.body: Voice has its own Inbox badge and filter. Call recordings are stored, and qualified leads have a dedicated view.

tools.title: Part of your everyday workflow.
tools.intro: Your voice agent connects to the same workspace.

goodToKnow.title: What to know before you connect.
items: Real phone calls require a connected telephony provider.
Voice minutes are billed as credits.
English, Hindi and Telugu are supported. You can lock an agent to one language.
The conversations shown here demonstrate example call flows you can configure for your business.

items.q: Can customers call a real phone number?
items.a: Yes. Connect a telephony provider from the dashboard. Inbound calls are routed to the right business agent by the number dialled.
Yes. Outbound calls and call campaigns are supported, with automatic pacing, retries for no-answer, busy and temporary errors, and a do-not-call list that is respected.
English, Hindi and Telugu. Choose the language in the Voice tab, preview the greeting and configure how names are pronounced.

items.q: What happens if a caller needs a person?
items.a: Calls can be transferred to a human. Outside business hours, a voicemail becomes a callback ticket.

items.q: Is this different from the AI receptionist?
items.a: The receptionist page focuses on inbound front-desk calls. The calling agent also covers outbound campaigns, qualification flows and voice conversations on your website.
Voice minutes are billed as credits. Connect your telephony provider from the dashboard before using real phone calls.

cta.title: Bring a real customer question to the demo.
cta.body: We’ll walk through how your voice agent can answer, qualify the enquiry and connect the caller with the next step.
